nodes.no_confusable_reason: This item retrieves the complete source rule concerning check exit space before crossing; no substitute rule for that exact condition is introduced.

nodes.no_confusable_reason: This item retrieves the complete source rule concerning shift before the tracks; no substitute rule for that exact condition is introduced.

nodes.label: Never race a train, and expect to stop behind vehicles legally required to stop at crossings.

nodes.no_confusable_reason: This item retrieves the complete source rule concerning do not race rail traffic; no substitute rule for that exact condition is introduced.

nodes.label: In urban areas, stop before the sidewalk when leaving an alley, building, private road or driveway; without a sidewalk, stop near the street where approaching traffic is visible.

pedagogic_emphasis.basis: Equal authored attention to accepted source statements.

nodes.no_confusable_reason: This item retrieves the complete source rule concerning stop before sidewalk or at visible street approach; no substitute rule for that exact condition is introduced.

pedagogic_emphasis.basis: Equal authored attention to accepted source statements.

nodes.no_confusable_reason: This item retrieves the complete source rule concerning exit yields and signals after stopping; no substitute rule for that exact condition is introduced.

nodes.label: When parking on a hill, select park and set the parking brake if necessary.

pedagogic_emphasis.basis: Equal authored attention to accepted source statements.

nodes.no_confusable_reason: This item retrieves the complete source rule concerning hill parking secures the vehicle; no substitute rule for that exact condition is introduced.

nodes.label: Before leaving a parked uphill or downhill position, release the parking brake, signal, check approaching traffic and proceed only when safe.

pedagogic_emphasis.basis: Equal authored attention to accepted source statements.

nodes.no_confusable_reason: This item retrieves the complete source rule concerning slope departure checks before movement; no substitute rule for that exact condition is introduced.

nodes.label: When parked facing downhill beside a curb, angle the front wheels toward that curb.

pedagogic_emphasis.basis: Equal authored attention to accepted source statements.

nodes.no_confusable_reason: This item retrieves the complete source rule concerning downhill wheels toward curb; no substitute rule for that exact condition is introduced.

nodes.label: When parked facing uphill beside a curb, angle the front wheels away from that curb.

pedagogic_emphasis.basis: Equal authored attention to accepted source statements.

nodes.no_confusable_reason: This item retrieves the complete source rule concerning uphill wheels away from curb; no substitute rule for that exact condition is introduced.

nodes.label: Without a curb, turn the wheels toward the roadside where the vehicle is parked, whether facing uphill or downhill.

pedagogic_emphasis.basis: Equal authored attention to accepted source statements.

nodes.no_confusable_reason: This item retrieves the complete source rule concerning no curb, wheels toward roadside; no substitute rule for that exact condition is introduced.

nodes.label: On a two-way road, parallel-park with the right wheels no more than twelve inches from the curb.

pedagogic_emphasis.basis: Equal authored attention to accepted source statements.

nodes.no_confusable_reason: This item retrieves the complete source rule concerning two-way parking uses right curb; no substitute rule for that exact condition is introduced.

nodes.label: On a one-way road, park within twelve inches of either curb and always face the direction of traffic travel.

nodes.no_confusable_reason: This item retrieves the complete source rule concerning one-way curb choice still follows traffic; no substitute rule for that exact condition is introduced.

nodes.label: Using a disability-reserved space requires qualifying plates or a placard, and the authorized holder must be present and entering or leaving the vehicle.

nodes.no_confusable_reason: This item retrieves the complete source rule concerning disability privilege follows authorized holder; no substitute rule for that exact condition is introduced.

nodes.label: The striped area beside an accessible space is reserved space and cannot be parked in even by a vehicle with disability parking credentials.

nodes.no_confusable_reason: This item retrieves the complete source rule concerning access stripes are not a parking space; no substitute rule for that exact condition is introduced.

nodes.label: A parking space designated for electric-vehicle charging may be occupied only by an electric vehicle.

pedagogic_emphasis.basis: Equal authored attention to accepted source statements.

nodes.no_confusable_reason: This item retrieves the complete source rule concerning electric charging space is reserved; no substitute rule for that exact condition is introduced.

nodes.label: Do not double-park or stop on a sidewalk, crosswalk, within an intersection or between a safety zone and its adjacent curb.

pedagogic_emphasis.basis: Equal authored attention to accepted source statements.

nodes.no_confusable_reason: This item retrieves the complete source rule concerning keep pedestrian and safety areas clear; no substitute rule for that exact condition is introduced.

nodes.label: Stopping, standing and parking are prohibited in marked, buffered or barrel-protected bicycle lanes.

pedagogic_emphasis.basis: Equal authored attention to accepted source statements.

nodes.no_confusable_reason: This item retrieves the complete source rule concerning protected bicycle space remains clear; no substitute rule for that exact condition is introduced.

nodes.label: Do not stop beside or opposite street work or an obstruction if doing so blocks traffic.

pedagogic_emphasis.basis: Equal authored attention to accepted source statements.

nodes.no_confusable_reason: This item retrieves the complete source rule concerning do not block passage beside an obstruction; no substitute rule for that exact condition is introduced.

nodes.label: Stopping, standing and parking are prohibited on bridges, overpasses, railway tracks, in highway tunnels and on controlled-access roadways.

nodes.no_confusable_reason: This item retrieves the complete source rule concerning structures and controlled-access roads are not stopping places; no substitute rule for that exact condition is introduced.

nodes.label: Do not stop, stand or park between the roadways of a divided highway, including a crossover.

nodes.no_confusable_reason: This item retrieves the complete source rule concerning divided-road crossover is not parking; no substitute rule for that exact condition is introduced.

nodes.label: Outside business and residential districts, use a practical off-road stopping place rather than the paved highway; an emergency roadway stop requires two hundred feet of clear view each way, warning flashers and room for traffic to pass.

nodes.label: Official no-stopping, no-standing or no-parking signs must be obeyed even though some statewide restrictions need no sign.

nodes.no_confusable_reason: This item retrieves the complete source rule concerning signs supplement statewide stopping rules; no substitute rule for that exact condition is introduced.

nodes.label: Do not stand or park in front of a public or private driveway or within fifteen feet of a fire hydrant, whether the vehicle is occupied or empty.

nodes.no_confusable_reason: This item retrieves the complete source rule concerning keep driveways and hydrants accessible; no substitute rule for that exact condition is introduced.

nodes.label: The listed standing-and-parking clearance is twenty feet from a fire-station driveway or an intersection crosswalk.

nodes.no_confusable_reason: This item retrieves the complete source rule concerning twenty-foot clearance at listed locations; no substitute rule for that exact condition is introduced.

nodes.no_confusable_reason: This item retrieves the complete source rule concerning traffic controls need thirty-foot clearance; no substitute rule for that exact condition is introduced.

nodes.label: Parking is prohibited within fifty feet of the closest railway rail.

nodes.no_confusable_reason: This item retrieves the complete source rule concerning rail crossing needs fifty-foot parking clearance; no substitute rule for that exact condition is introduced.

nodes.label: A highway-parked vehicle needs front and rear parking lamps between sunset and sunrise unless an urban-district exception applies, and its headlights must be dimmed.

nodes.no_confusable_reason: This item retrieves the complete source rule concerning do not target moving vehicles with falling objects; no substitute rule for that exact condition is introduced.

nodes.no_confusable_reason: This item retrieves the complete source rule concerning load cannot obstruct vision or exceed belts; no substitute rule for that exact condition is introduced.
